content_zh:
“和刚才你应聘的那家差不多的性质，不过似乎更有挑战性一点，当然薪酬也更高一些。这是个公平的世界，高风险才有高回报。怎么样，有兴趣么？”英俊的中年人微微一笑。
林锐皱眉道，“也是一家保安公司？”
“准确的说是军事保安公司。”那个中年人平静地道，“我的车就在路口，不介意的话，我们找个地方聊聊。也许，你会对我提供的职位感兴趣。”在路口停着一辆黑色的轿车。
林锐犹豫了一下，还是跟着这个人一起上了车。上车之后那个人径直开车把林锐带到了市区的一栋办公楼里。
“坐吧。”中年人平静地道。
林锐点点头，他看了一眼这个陌生的地方，犹豫了一下但还是坐了下来。
“自我介绍一下，我姓米，你可以叫我米先生。虽然你在路上一直没有开口问，但是我知道，你一定在想，我们公司和一般的的保安公司有什么区别。”中年男人微笑道。
林锐沉默了一会儿道，“有什么区别？”
“首先，我可以告诉你，我们是一家境外的私营企业。高福利，高薪酬，高效率，但同时也是高危险行业。”米先生看着林锐道。
“有多危险？”林锐皱眉道。
“伤残，甚至死亡，甚至比这些更糟，就是在战场上被俘。”米先生淡淡地道。
林锐有些怀疑自己的耳朵，他站起身道，“战场？被俘？你们是什么人。”
“我们公司的全称叫做晨星军事咨询公司，简称SUM。我可以为你提供一份雇佣合约，薪酬绝对超乎你的想象，当然风险也是超乎你的想象。”米先生微微一笑道。“我们的公司业务很大，而且近十几年来，在世界各个热点地区，都能够找到我们的影子。简单的说我们受雇于任何国家，在任何地区执行军事任务。”
林锐皱眉道，“你的意思是雇佣兵公司？”
“也有人这么说，不过这样的词汇显然很不专业。而我们是一家专业的军事咨询公司，所以我更愿意称自己为军事安全雇员。”米先生一笑道，“有人的地方，就有战争。有战争就有生意，我们就是这样一些人。目前的世界，趋于平稳，不太可能出现类似二战的大规模战争，但是小规模的局部冲突却从来不断。这就保证了我们的生意从来就没有断过。”
林锐摇摇头道，“也许正是你们这样的人存在，才到导致了这个世界冲突不断。我没有兴趣。”
“年轻人，你完全错了。这个世界有冲突，在于有人，有利益。人在为了利益而战。即便没有我们，照样会有战争存在。我们只是利用我们的专业技能，在战争之中混口饭吃的人。”米先生微微一笑。“我知道，你现在极度缺钱。相信我，这只是打一份工而已。和你在其他地方打工没有本质上的区别。”
“我不相信你。”林锐摇头道。
“我知道信任不是一天之内可以建立的，但是你完全可以相信我。因为我和你一样，也曾经是个退伍军人。”米先生平静地笑了笑。“你曾经是个战士，应该知道最可以信任的人就是你的战友。你可以放心把自己的后背交给那个人，因为你知道他也同样信任你。你们只有互相信任，才能生存下来。我就是你的战友。”
“不行，我不可能离开这里，我家里还有病人。”林锐摇摇头。

“我知道，其实你也许不太相信。我调查过你，你爷爷身体很差，而且患有老年痴呆。而且你本人的经济状况很差，并不能很好的赡养他。不过你只要签了我的这份合同，我可以立刻支付你一笔签约费用。你不但可以偿还所有的债务，还能聘请专业的护理人员负责照料他。”米先生平静地道。
“你知道我欠了多少债？”林锐苦笑着道。
“一共三十万左右，是你父亲生前欠下的。”米先生淡淡一笑道，“看来你并不了解这份工作的含义。我举个例子说吧，海湾战争期间，我们公司的某些军事人员日薪就是一万，而且是美元。就像我所说的，高风险理应得到高回报。”
林锐愣住了，他沉默了一会儿道，“你说的这些是真的？”
“我在大街上拦住你，把你拖到这里了跟你说这么多话，你不会以为我是在逗你玩吧？”米先生叹了一口气道，“我看起来真的像是这么无聊的人么？”

content_en:
"It's similar in nature to the one you just applied for, but it seems a little more challenging, and of course the salary is higher. This is a fair world, and only high risks bring high rewards. How about it, are you interested?" The handsome middle-aged man smiled slightly.
Lin Rui frowned and said, "Is it also a security company?"
"To be precise, it's a military security company." The middle-aged man said calmly, "My car is at the intersection. If you don't mind, we can find a place to chat. Maybe you will be interested in the position I offer." There was a black car parked at the intersection.
Lin Rui hesitated for a moment, then followed this man and got into the car. After getting in the car, the man drove Lin Rui directly to an office building in the city.
"Sit down." The middle-aged man said calmly.
Lin Rui nodded. He glanced at this unfamiliar place and hesitated for a moment but still sat down.
"Let me introduce myself. My surname is Mi. You can call me Mr. Mi. Although you never asked me on the way, I know you must be thinking about the difference between our company and ordinary security companies." The middle-aged man smiled.
Lin Rui was silent for a while and said, "What's the difference?"
"First of all, I can tell you that we are an overseas private enterprise. We have high benefits, high salary, and high efficiency, but it is also a high-risk industry." Mr. Mi looked at Lin Rui and said.
"How dangerous is it?" Lin Rui frowned.
"Being disabled or even dead, or even worse than that, being captured on the battlefield." Mr. Mi said calmly.
Lin Rui doubted his ears. He stood up and said, "Battlefield? Captured? Who are you?"
"The full name of our company is Morningstar Military Consulting, or SUM for short. I can provide you with an employment contract. The salary will definitely exceed your imagination. Of course, the risks will also exceed your imagination." Mr. Mi smiled slightly. "Our company has a large business, and in the past decade or so, we can be found in various hotspots around the world. Simply put, we are employed by any country and perform military tasks in any region."
Lin Rui frowned and said, "You mean the mercenary company?"
"Some people say that, but such terms are obviously very unprofessional. We are a professional military consulting company, so I prefer to call myself a military security employee." Mr. Mi smiled and said, "Where there are people, there are wars. Where there are wars, there is business. We are such people. The current world is stabilizing, and large-scale wars like World War II are unlikely to occur, but small-scale local conflicts have never stopped. This ensures that our business has never been interrupted."
Lin Rui shook his head and said, "Maybe it is the existence of people like you that causes constant conflicts in this world. I am not interested."
"Young man, you are completely wrong. There are conflicts in this world because there are people and interests. People are fighting for interests. Even without us, there will still be wars. We are just people who use our professional skills to make a living in the war." Mr. Mi smiled slightly. "I know you are extremely short of money right now. Believe me, this is just a job. It is not fundamentally different from working elsewhere."
"I don't believe you." Lin Rui shook his head.
"I know trust cannot be built in a day, but you can trust me. Because like you, I was once a veteran." Mr. Mi smiled calmly. "You were once a soldier, and you should know that the person you can trust the most is your comrade. You can trust that person with your back, because you know he also trusts you. Only by trusting each other can you survive. I am your comrade."
"No, I can't leave here. I still have patients at home." Lin Rui shook his head.
"I know, actually you mightDon't quite believe it. I have investigated you and found that your grandfather is in poor health and suffers from Alzheimer's disease. Moreover, your own financial situation is very poor and you cannot support him well. But as long as you sign my contract, I can pay you a signing fee immediately. Not only can you pay off all your debts, but you can also hire professional caregivers to take care of him. "Mr. Mi said calmly.
“Do you know how much debt I owe? Lin Rui said with a bitter smile.
“A total of about 300,000 yuan was owed by your father during his lifetime. Mr. Mi smiled lightly and said, "It seems you don't understand the meaning of this job." Let me give you an example. During the Gulf War, some military personnel in our company received a daily salary of 10,000 U.S. dollars. Like I said, high risk deserves high reward. "
Lin Rui was stunned, he was silent for a while and said, "Is what you said true? "
"I stopped you on the street, dragged you here, and talked to you so much, you didn't think I was teasing you, right? Mr. Mi sighed and said, "Do I really look like such a boring person?" "
